meta.title: Vendor Self-Registration (OTP): refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Vendor role and test Vendor Self-Registration with email and phone OTP verification
Repeat Vendor Self-Registration with a user holding the Vendor role
Compare the refused or absent action for the non-Vendor user with the available action for the Vendor user
Record whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Vendor role and test Vendor Self-Registration with email and phone OTP verification; Repeat Vendor Self-Registration with a user holding the Vendor role; Compare the refused or absent action for the non-Vendor user with the available action for the Vendor user; Record whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles
